features.name: stack spoof invalid module name handling
features.notes: Rejected interior-NUL module names in `stack_spoof::find_gadgets` so `GetModuleHandleA` cannot silently resolve the calling module, added regression coverage, and documented that frame rewriting still operates on the live RBP chain heuristically rather than validating each original return address against a target module.
